name: CF Master
description: CF Master: 1979 Comfortably Numb studio rig (Ram's Head Muff -> Electric Mistress -> MXR DDS-1 Delay -> Hiwatt DR103/WEM || Alembic F-2B/Yamaha RA-200 Rotary in stereo). 5 patch slots (header 0x58 = 5).

params.name: Muff Sust
params.explanation: Ram's Head Big Muff sustain / fuzz gain.

params.name: Muff Tone
params.explanation: Big Muff tone tilt filter (mid scoop).

params.name: Mist Colr
params.explanation: Electric Mistress BBD feedback / comb depth.

params.name: Dly Time
params.explanation: MXR DDS-1 delay time in ms (default 480 ms).

params.name: Amp Drive
params.explanation: Hiwatt DR103 preamp volume / input drive.

params.name: Amp Mstr
params.explanation: Hiwatt DR103 master volume and power sag.

params.name: Rotor
params.explanation: Yamaha RA-200 rotor mode: 0 = Off, 1 = Slow (chorus), 2 = Fast.

params.name: Rot Speed
params.explanation: RA-200 slow rotor speed adjustment (0.4 - 3.0 Hz).
